messages.author: 5f1cb0ac57baae2b
messages.subject: Repeated data in exported csv
parts:
Hi Filipe, 

My input data sheet is 20 observations (plots) of 4 variables. I run my image and extract 4 VI's with fieldIndex and fieldInfo. I expect 20 observations of 10 variables but instead I have 400 observations of 10 variables with 20 repeats of each observation/plot. it appears in EX.info$fieldShape and EX.info$plotValue as 400x10 and 400x5 respectively. However, in EX.shape$fieldShape is 20x5. Do you know what might be causing my data sheet to multiply plots by 20?

Thanks, 

Eric

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Repeated data in exported csv
parts:
Hi Eric,

Thank you for contacting me. This is a BUG on version 0.3.0. 

We just fixed this issue in fieldInfo() and fieldArea(). Those functions were taking much more time than suppose to be because they were running the same loop many times on version 0.3.0. That's why you were observing 400.

Please download again FIELDimageR 0.3.1. 

devtools::install_github("filipematias23/FIELDimageR")

Let me know if is working properly now.

Thank you,
Filipe
